reference: Symptoms log for the doctor. The headache started Sunday evening around 9 PM. It's a dull pressure behind both eyes. On a scale of one to ten, it's about a seven when it's bad. I've been taking ibuprofen 600mg every eight hours — it helps for about four hours, then comes back. I also have neck stiffness in the mornings, goes away after about 30 minutes. No fever (37.2°C, normal). No nausea. Mild light sensitivity, but only in direct sunlight. Similar headache about three weeks ago, lasted four days, went away on its own. No recent head injuries. Sleep is fine, about seven to eight hours a night.
